verses.text: For the choir director, for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, 'I will guard my ways That I may not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth as with a muzzle While the wicked are in my presence.'
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩，交與伶長耶杜頓。）我曾說：我要謹慎我的言行，免得我舌頭犯罪；惡人在我面前的時候，我要用嚼環勒住我的口。

verses.text: I was mute and silent, I refrained [even] from good, And my sorrow grew worse.
verses.textZh: 我默然無聲，連好話也不出口；我的愁苦就發動了，

verses.text: My heart was hot within me, While I was musing the fire burned; [Then] I spoke with my tongue:
verses.textZh: 我的心在我裡面發熱。我默想的時候，火就燒起，我便用舌頭說話。

verses.text: 'LORD, make me to know my end And what is the extent of my days; Let me know how transient I am.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你叫我曉得我身之終！我的壽數幾何？叫我知道我的生命不長！

verses.text: 'Behold, You have made my days [as] handbreadths, And my lifetime as nothing in Your sight; Surely every man at his best is a mere breath. Selah.
verses.textZh: 你使我的年日窄如手掌；我一生的年數，在你面前如同無有。各人最穩妥的時候，真是全然虛幻。（細拉）

verses.text: 'Surely every man walks about as a phantom; Surely they make an uproar for nothing; He amasses [riches] and does not know who will gather them.
verses.textZh: 世人行動實係幻影。他們忙亂，真是枉然；積蓄財寶，不知將來有誰收取。

verses.text: 'And now, Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
verses.textZh: 主啊，如今我等甚麼呢？我的指望在乎你！

verses.text: 'Deliver me from all my transgressions; Make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.textZh: 求你救我脫離一切的過犯，不要使我受愚頑人的羞辱。

verses.text: 'I have become mute, I do not open my mouth, Because it is You who have done [it].
verses.textZh: 因我所遭遇的是出於你，我就默然不語。

verses.text: 'Remove Your plague from me; Because of the opposition of Your hand I am perishing.
verses.textZh: 求你把你的責罰從我身上免去；因你手的責打，我便消滅。

verses.text: 'With reproofs You chasten a man for iniquity; You consume as a moth what is precious to him; Surely every man is a mere breath. Selah.
verses.textZh: 你因人的罪惡懲罰他的時候，叫他的笑容（的笑容：或譯所喜愛的）消滅，如衣被蟲所咬。世人真是虛幻！（細拉）

verses.text: 'Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry; Do not be silent at my tears; For I am a stranger with You, A sojourner like all my fathers.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，留心聽我的呼求！我流淚，求你不要靜默無聲！因為我在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我列祖一般。

verses.text: 'Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may smile [again] Before I depart and am no more.'
verses.textZh: 求你寬容我，使我在去而不返之先可以力量復原。
